power_notes: Track widths here are sized for the tracks that remain: plane taps and short stubs. The main currents ride on copper the width rules can't see: VBUS_IN/VBUS/PVDD/+3V3 on In2 plane regions plus F.Cu pours, and the amp OUT/SPK nets (3.7 A rms continuous sine, 2 x 56 W governor-capped) on the solid fan-in pours from kicad/gen/power_zones.py. check_irdrop covers those paths at P8. +3V3 is budgeted at 0.6 A for the ESP32-WROVER's radio bursts (~500 mA), from the 2 A SY8089 (U5) with 2 x 22 uF at L10 and 22 uF + 100 nF at U7. +5V stays at 0.5 A: U5 draws ~0.45 A at 5 V for the radio's peak, plus ~0.1 A for the amps' 5 V supplies and the analog LDO, so 0.55 A peak; six +5V layer changes have one via each, which check_current wants doubled at 0.6 A (follow-up). The real VBUS/PVDD current is the PD contract's 5 A (pd_source): check_power_path's max-flow over all layers carries it (J1->R1 7.45 A, R1->Q1 5.32 A, Q1->U15 7.45 A at dT 10 C). check_current's per-layer pour-neck rule fails at 5 A (In2 VBUS_IN/VBUS necks 1.9-2.2 mm, PVDD 0.81 mm on In2 and 1.0-1.5 mm on F.Cu, against 4.3 mm at dT 30 C), so its budgets stay at the tap-track 0.5 A and widening those necks is a follow-up task. The firmware governor holds the sustained input to ~13 W (0.47 A) and bursts to the 1 s supply budget.
diff_pairs_note: Explicitly empty. The USB full-speed pair (12 Mb/s) and the two 100BASE-TX pairs run about 10 mm, so coupling them adds nothing measurable, and the router doesn't couple pairs (route_critical's KRT diff pass shorted). They are routed as ordinary nets at the Default width.

enclosure.note: Plus box (enclosure/core_box.py via hive-mech) with U16 fitted: floor slots under U15 and U16 (2 x 4 x 2 x 16 mm), lid slots over them (2 x 5), the board's 0.6-2 mm edge gaps as the riser. other_w: the rest of core (~2.5 W) plus the output filters and bulk caps at the governed level (~1 W)
